# Password-protected PDF fixtures

`password-1.pdf` and `password-2.pdf` are synthetic one-page PDFs generated by
`generate_password_pdfs.py`. They contain only test text, a red rendering marker,
and a checkbox. No user document or credentials are included.

The opening passwords are `fixture-open-1` and `fixture-open-2`; the respective
owner passwords are `fixture-owner-1` and `fixture-owner-2`. The distinct passwords
exercise independent document and worker sessions.

`password-3.pdf` uses `fixture-open-3` / `fixture-owner-3` and permits only
extraction. It verifies that changing an opening password does not silently
remove permission restrictions, even when opened with the owner password.

The C++ tests use these checked-in files and require no Python packages. To
regenerate them with `reportlab` and `pypdf` installed, run:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/generate_password_pdfs.py
```

The fixed identifiers, ReportLab invariant mode, and RC4-128 encryption keep this
tiny fixture generation reproducible. The algorithm is a test-fixture choice.
